claimed_identity.description: Who the sender presents themselves as or represents; a brand mention alone is not affiliation.

claimed_relationship.description: Claimed or supported inferred relationship between sender and recipient.

communication_context.description: Visible matter or situation prompting the communication.

prior_context.description: Earlier contact or agreements referenced or included; distinguish a claim from an included exchange.

request_context_connection.description: How the request follows from the visible relationship and situation, or a supported gap in that connection.

inconsistencies_or_changes.description: Specific visible contradictions or changes. Cite both competing passages; do not invent expected procedures.

missing_context.description: Missing information needed to resolve a supported context question; missing consent does not establish lack of consent.

sender_domain.description: Domain in the supplied sender or From address; unknown when unavailable. Do not substitute URL domains.

reply_to_domain.description: Domain in an explicitly supplied Reply-To address; unknown when unavailable.

uncertainties.description: Unresolved issues limiting this role. Use supported findings when quotable; otherwise unknown/null/empty evidence. Use not_present/null/empty evidence if no relevant uncertainty is identified.

items.description: Brands or organizations actually mentioned, without authenticating affiliation.

brand_mentions.description: Brands or organizations actually mentioned, without authenticating affiliation.

items.description: Names of email header fields actually supplied in headers, not personal display names.

header_names.description: Names of email header fields actually supplied in headers, not personal display names.
